2-bromo-2-methylpropane, (CH$_3$)$_3$CBr, reacts with aqueous sodium hydroxide.

**(a)** State the type of mechanism and explain why this halogenoalkane reacts by it. **[2]**

**(b)** Write the rate equation for the reaction. **[1]**

**(c)** Describe the two steps of the mechanism, stating which is rate-determining. **[3]**
markscheme:
**(a)** S$_\text{N}$1 / unimolecular nucleophilic substitution ✓; the tertiary carbocation is stabilised by the positive inductive effect of three alkyl groups, and the bulky groups hinder backside attack ✓

**(b)** rate $= k[(\text{CH}_3)_3\text{CBr}]$ ✓

**(c)** Step 1: the C–Br bond breaks heterolytically to give (CH$_3$)$_3$C$^+$ and Br$^-$ ✓; this slow step is rate-determining ✓. Step 2: OH$^-$ (nucleophile) attacks the carbocation, forming (CH$_3$)$_3$COH ✓
